comment: The image's default: stock css:config/file.json, with three changes. Everything else is stock.
1. Pods are subdomains (alice.example.org), not folders (example.org/alice/). Decided for every NEW
instance (2026-10-14). NEVER switch an instance that already has folder pods: with the file backend,
subdomain mode reads data/alice/ as alice.example.org and moves the root to data/www/, so every
existing WebID, ACL and link would point at something else. Such an instance mounts
config/suffix.json instead (pocpod0 does).
2. The welcome page is the root container's index.html, written once on first start
(initialize-intro.json; the image puts our welcome where the stock intro page was). NOT
static-root.json: CSS 7.2's StaticAssetHandler matches the path and ignores the host, so with
subdomain pods it answered GET / on EVERY pod with the welcome page, Turtle requests included,
and no app could read a pod's root (checked against the image, 2026-10-14).
3. Authentication is stock dpop-bearer. pocpod0's UnsecureWebIdExtractor (trusts an unverified
'Authorization: WebID' header) never enters the image; an instance that needs it adds it in its
own config, knowingly, and strips the header at its gateway.

@graph.comment: util/identifiers/subdomain.json, restated rather than imported so the generator can be wrapped.

comment: Pod names become hostnames; CSS checks only that they are non-empty. PodNameGuard (pod-name-guard/
in this repo) answers 400 for a name that is not a valid DNS label after CSS's own clean-up
(open_fab, 64+ characters, a hyphen at either end) and for reserved names. Reserve here every
service host the gateway serves on this domain, or a pod of that name exists but is unreachable.
An instance with more service hosts mounts its own copy of this file with a longer list.

@graph.comment: util/identifiers/subdomain.json: www is the folder the bare domain is stored in (data/www/).

comment: The public .md page (solid-kit's doc-view, overlay/doc-view/, generated): main.html.ejs loads these.
Matched on the path only, like every static asset, so they also answer on each pod's subdomain:
a pod resource named /doc-view.js or /doc-view.css would be hidden. The rest of the overlay is
under CSS's own /.well-known/css/ and needs no entry here.

assets.comment: What this instance offers (solid-kit ADR 010), written at start by start/describe.js. Under /.well-known/css/, which already answers on every pod.
